overview.stopped.title: Windows is off
overview.stopped.body: Its screen appears here when you start it. Your apps and files are as you left them.
overview.stowed.title: Windows is suspended
overview.stowed.body: Its memory is saved on disk. Start it to pick up exactly where you left off.
overview.missing.title: Set up Windows
overview.missing.body: Start creates a new Windows from your image, and its screen appears here.
overview.missing.noImage: No image yet? Build one in Terminal:
overview.starting.title: Starting Windows
overview.starting.body: Its screen appears here in a moment.
step.disk: Create a disk from your image
abilities.title: Also from Terminal
ability.saves: Save this moment and come back to it
ability.agent: Let an agent see and use the screen
screen.refused: The screen didn't accept the password. Shut Windows down and start it again.
host.notReady: This Mac can't run Windows yet
host.runtimeMissing: The runtime that runs Windows isn't installed.
error.status: Couldn't get the status of Windows
cli.body: Install the winvm command to use it in Terminal. It goes in ~/.local/bin.
trouble.forceStopBody: If Windows stops responding, turn it off without shutting down.
confirm.stop.title: Shut down Windows?
confirm.stop.body: Windows shuts down the same way as from its Start menu. Save your work in Windows first.
confirm.reboot.title: Restart Windows?
confirm.reboot.body: Windows restarts the same way as from its Start menu. Save your work in Windows first.
confirm.kill.title: Turn off Windows?
confirm.kill.body: Windows turns off immediately, like pulling the plug. Anything you haven't saved in Windows is lost.
